summary: A Toronto family and criminal law office with a bail hotline appears to lose enquiries to stray page code, no online form and no instant message option.

findings.problem: Stray markup characters appear about three times in the page text near the header.
findings.cost: Broken code on the first screen looks careless to a client in a crisis.

findings.problem: No online enquiry form appears, only a phone number and an email address.
findings.cost: Many clients prefer to leave details at night instead of calling.
findings.fix: A short confidential enquiry form with matter type.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp or WeChat option appears, even though the site offers Chinese language pages.
findings.cost: Chinese speaking clients often message first.
findings.fix: WhatsApp and WeChat contact on every page.

findings.problem: English such as court attending experience and As a very professional divorce lawyer appears on the homepage.
findings.cost: Awkward phrases weaken a lawyer's credibility.
